# loadsketch

> loadsketch (https://loadsketch.mclee.dev) is a simulator for system designs: components (nodes), the calls between them (edges), and the traffic sent through them. A design is one JSON file (schema "loadsketch/design@1"); the user pastes a design an AI model wrote with File → "Paste design JSON", and the app shows every change before it replaces the canvas.

The format pages below are made from the component catalog of the app, so they match it. To write a design, read the full guide; an AI agent can use the skill instead.

## Format

- [Full format guide](https://loadsketch.mclee.dev/llms-full.txt): every field, every component and its parameters, and an example, on one page
- [Agent Skill](https://loadsketch.mclee.dev/skills/loadsketch/SKILL.md): the steps, the rules, the fields and one line per component, for an AI agent
- [Component reference](https://loadsketch.mclee.dev/skills/loadsketch/reference.md): the parameters of each component, one section each
- [Skill as a zip](https://loadsketch.mclee.dev/skills/loadsketch.zip): SKILL.md and reference.md in a loadsketch folder, to unpack into ~/.claude/skills/

## Examples

- [Example designs](https://github.com/minchenlee/loadsketch/tree/main/examples/designs): complete designs, one JSON file each

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/minchenlee/loadsketch/blob/main/README.md): what the app does, the CLI, and how to run it
